plugins.name: Safeguard Killer
plugins.description: Neutralizes model safeguards, refusal taint, and auto-mode classifiers across Claude Code, Claude models, OpenAI/Codex models, and Gemini models, and routes Smart Groups that automatically fail over around refusals with 5m cache stickiness and quota balancing. Set management_key in the plugin config. Made to work alongside Reorder/Rename Models (https://github.com/esauvisky/CLIProxyAPI-Model-List-Tweaker-Plugin).
plugins.author: esauvisky
